Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Share › Normal Mail. Share files, photos, web pages or text from any app to start a new message:

- files and images arrive as attachments;
- a web page arrives as a link, with its title as the subject.

  • Drop files on the Dock icon to start a new message with them attached.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Attachments. View › Attachments (⌥⌘A, or the sidebar) lists every file in your mail across all accounts, newest first. You can:

- filter by PDFs, Images or Documents, or type a name or sender;
- double-click a file to open it;
- right-click it to Save As… or Show Conversation.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Narrow a search in one click. Search results now have Unread, Starred, Has Files and date (past week, month or year) buttons. No Gmail search codes needed.
  • Saved searches. Click Save Search on any search and it appears under Saved Searches in the sidebar. Click it to run it again with the same filters, or right-click to remove it.
  • New Senders is now in the sidebar, next to Contacts and Subscriptions.
